title: Safai Saathi adoption record
description: Who has caught up with which change. Each app updates its own record in its own repo, in .contract/adopted.json. This file is the platform's aggregated view. It is a REPORT, not a source of truth. The truth is each app's own file.

x-rules.sourceOfTruth: Each app's own .contract/adopted.json in its own repo. This file is generated from those files and this repo's manifest. An app with no file shows contractVersion null and adoptionFile null, and its statuses are derived from the manifest, never carried as evidence.
x-rules.noChecklistNoProgress: An app with no checklist shows 0 percent, not 100 percent.
x-rules.evidenceRequired: A status of adopted needs a merged PR as evidence. The CI tool checks it.
x-rules.notApplicable: A status of not_applicable needs a note saying why.
x-rules.generatedBy: Generated by 08-tools/sync-adoption.ts from each app's .contract/adopted.json and this repo's manifest. Do not hand-edit the statuses.

CHG-0001.note: The app already matches the frozen collection and field contract. The write-path audit on 2026-11-02 found every persisted field except trips.id to be exactly the core shape.

CHG-0002.note: The driver app READS drivers.phone from the drivers doc. The core schema now says phoneMasked, and the raw phone moves to staffPhones. The driver app's Driver model still carries a raw phone field at lib/core/models/driver.dart:88. It reads the driver doc but never writes it, so the migration is read-side only: read phoneMasked, and show the masked form.

CHG-0003.note: The driver app signs in anonymously and has no custom claims yet. It needs the vanId and driverId claims from bindDeviceToVan before the tightened rules can scope it. This is the P0 item and it blocks the rules deploy.

CHG-0005.note: The driver app still appends the whole GPS trail into trips.gpsTrail as one array. The sharded trail lives in trips/{id}/trail subcollection documents with the trailChunk schema. The write path is lib/core/repositories/firestore/firestore_trips_repository.dart:34-38 and the Hive buffer at lib/features/tracking/data/hive_trail_buffer.dart.
